chapter.heading: Assurance of God’s Victory over EnemiesA Song. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
O God,
my heart is steadfast;I will sing and give praise, even with my glory. [Eph. 5:14] [Mal. 4:2]

Awake, lute
and harp!I will awaken the dawn.

I will
praise You, O Lord, among the peoples,And I will sing praises to You among the nations. [Is. 49:6, 23; Rev.]

For Your
mercy is great above the heavens,And Your truth reaches to the clouds. [Is. 49:18 e Is.]

That Your
beloved may be delivered,Save with Your right hand, and hear me. [Gen. 25:4] [Gen. 25:3; Ps. 72:10 i Is. 61:6; Matt. 2:11]

God has
spoken in His holiness:“I will rejoice;I will divide ShechemAnd measure out the Valley of Succoth. [Gen. 25:13 k Is. 56:7 l Is. 60:13; Hag. 2:7,]

Gilead is
Mine; Manasseh is Mine;Ephraim also is the helmet for My head;Judah is My lawgiver.

Moab is
My washpot;Over Edom I will cast My shoe;Over Philistia I will triumph.” [Ps. 72:10 n [Gal. 4:26] o Jer. 3:17 p Is. 55:5]

Who will
bring me into the strong city?Who will lead me to Edom? [Is. 14:1, 2; 61:5; Zech. 6:15] [Is. 49:23; Rev. 21:24 s Is. 57:17] [Is. 54:7,]

Is it
not You, O God, who cast us off?And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?

Give us
help from trouble,For the help of man is useless. [Is. 14:2; Zech. 14:17; Matt. 21:44]

Through God
we will do valiantly,For it is He who shall tread down our enemies. [Is. 35:2 x 1 Chr. 28:2; Ps.]
